title: The Gallery of Perfect Refusals

features.name: the-first-refusal
features.desc-on-touch: A shopfront window holding nothing but its own frame — the frame has learned perfection is emptiness.

features.name: the-archive-s-no
features.desc-on-touch: A plaque of unreadable writing that refuses to resolve into meaning — the glyph that has learned not to decode itself.

features.name: the-tower-that-means-nothing
features.desc-on-touch: A tower rendered in perfect diagnostic geometry — so perfect it has stopped being a thing and become only the idea of refusal.

features.name: the-circuit-that-chooses-silence
features.desc-on-touch: A chip rendered so cleanly it seems to have refused all current — the hardware has learned to say no.

inscription: what refuses to continue is never less perfect for its silence

file.name: Exhibitions_Held_in_Absence_1994-2003.txt
file.note: A catalog of shows that never happened, curated in perfect detail; each listing describes exactly nothing.

exits.label: upward to galleries that are only mirrors
rightward into chambers where refusal has walls
downward to the storage beneath perfect curation
